summary: BooksOnline meets every hard constraint and all customer-journey features are implemented end to end across DB, API, and UI. The stack is 100% Bun-native: ONE Bun.serve() on ONE port routes /api/* to the Elysia app and serves the HTML-imported React SPA bundled by Bun with bun-plugin-tailwind (bunfig.toml [serve.static]); no Vite/Webpack/esbuild/Node tooling exists in source. Persistence is bun:sqlite with idempotent auto schema+seed of 23 real popular books across 7 categories/21 publishers, priced in INR paise with working Open Library cover URLs (verified HTTP 200 image/jpeg). Auth is real: Bun.password argon2id hashing, stateless HS256 JWT (env JWT_SECRET with a documented dev fallback, timing-safe signature check, 7d expiry), a reusable guard that re-loads the user from the DB, and strict server-side per-user isolation (verified live: user B gets 404/empty on user A's order/cart/orders). shadcn is new-york/neutral/cssVariables/lucide; lucide-react icons only with the specified meetup2.svg logo in nav/home/favicon; no emojis found in frontend source. Checkout is a fully mocked Pay / Cancel Payment card creating a 'paid'/'MOCK' order (server recomputes prices, clamps point redemption, never trusts the client), and the confirmation shows EXACTLY 'The product has been purchased successfully and will be delivered soon'. Cancel-within-48h is enforced server-side against the stored timestamp (verified: a constructed >48h order returns 403 'Cancellation window expired'). INR formatINR() is used across every screen. Verification is green: bunx tsc --noEmit clean, bun test 54/54 pass, and a live bounded end-to-end run (register -> cart -> address -> mocked checkout -> buy-again -> history recommendations -> cancel within window -> stale-order 403 -> cross-user isolation -> unauthenticated 401) all passed. Server was stopped and temp/db artifacts cleaned; store.sqlite stays gitignored.

findings.detail: JWT HS256 sign/verify is hand-rolled rather than using a vetted library. It is implemented correctly (base64url, timing-safe comparison, exp check), so this is not a blocker, but consider a maintained JWT library (or Elysia's @elysiajs/jwt) if the surface grows, to reduce the chance of future crypto mistakes.

The gift-points discount shown before Pay is a client-side preview (PAISE_PER_POINT=100); the server recomputes authoritatively on order creation. This is intentional and documented, but there is no server 'order total preview' endpoint, so an edge case (e.g. balance changed in another tab) could briefly show a stale preview before the authoritative total returns. Non-blocking; optional to add a preview endpoint.

PATCH/DELETE /api/addresses exist and are tested server-side, but the storefront UI only lists/selects/creates addresses; edit/delete are not surfaced. Not required by the journey scope, noted for completeness.
